system.description:
You manipulate the Water Release Chakra molding it until you create a cloud 1 mile in air. This cloud is then sent to hover over a creature you can see within range, and begins to rain down red rain, filling a 15-foot wide, 1-mile-tall Cylinder, centering on a point of the space the creature is in. All creatures who are within the radius are rained on and have their clothing soaked with this red rain that dulls their senses.

For the duration when a creature within this jutsu’s radius would make a saving throw to resist a jutsu with the Water release keyword, you may roll a d4 reducing their saving throws by the result.

As a bonus action on your turn, you may move the cloud 30 feet raining on the new space.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank increase the cost by 3 and the width of the cylinder by 10-feet. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, all creatures who begin their turn in this jutsu’s affected area increase the cost of jutsu they cast by +4. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank or Higher, all creatures who begin their turn in this jutsu’s affected area increase the cost of jutsu they cast by an additional +8.
